title: A股港股早报：流动性与科技业绩托底，弱宽度和高油价约束反弹
summary: 7000亿元MLF与AI就业政策改善本地预期，德明利、光迅科技和寒武纪三季报映射存储、光通信与国产算力；但10月23日A股下跌4872家、油价仍高，周一期指反弹需由本地量价确认。

关键词云图

MLF投放AI就业政策存储业绩油气高位激光雷达网络安全光通信国产算力电信压力指数新规A股弱宽度港股分化
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
中东袭击延续，原油从近六个月高位回吐
周末胡塞武装继续袭击沙特机场和石油设施；周一08:18 CST，WTI报101.67美元、跌1.55%，Brent报115.16美元、跌1.34%。油价回落缓解边际通胀压力，但供应风险尚未解除。
政策
央行今日开展7000亿元一年期MLF操作
中国人民银行10月23日公告，为保持银行体系流动性充裕，10月26日以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展7000亿元MLF；利好流动性预期，价格仍取决于中标利率。
政策
国务院部署AI发展与就业友好型转型
10月24日公开的国办发〔2026〕29号提出AI中小企业创业支持、开源社区、智能终端制造与专项培训，同时要求评估就业替代风险；对软件、算力与终端是政策支撑，也带来合规约束。
交易所
上证系列综合指数编制修订今日实施
上交所修订规则增加单个样本15%权重上限，并调整风险警示证券剔除时间；今日实施，可能改变权重股和风险警示证券的被动资金扰动。
美股
油气链领涨而电信服务承压
10月23日Moomoo行业榜显示油气钻探+6.15%、油服+4.94%；Reuters显示能源板块涨2.5%。电信服务行业跌3.16%，AT&T和T-Mobile因SpaceX潜在第四家运营商竞争均跌近8%；A/H能源映射偏正面，运营商冲击更多是美国特有竞争结构。
美股
激光雷达、网络安全与存储概念走强
概念榜中激光雷达+5.78%（LIDR +10.41%）、网络安全+4.55%（SAIL +8.62%）、存储+2.19%（SKHY +4.05%）；对应A/H智能驾驶、安全软件和存储链，但周一期指反弹尚无代表股夜盘逐项报价确认。
产业
智元开源真实场景具身推理数据集
盘前发现源显示智元发布AGIBOT WORLD 2026第四期，覆盖九类真实推理场景与动作轨迹；利好机器人数据与训练生态，但未见上市公司订单或收入确认，不直接形成个股卡。
业绩
德明利三季度营收与利润大幅增长
巨潮披露显示单季营收116.45亿元、同比+356.64%，归母净利润27.29亿元、同比+2902.75%，企业级存储收入占比提升；10月23日收于251.00元、+3.22%，周末报告后尚无交易确认。
业绩
寒武纪三季度收入利润双增
公司三季报显示单季营收35.31亿元、同比+104.47%，归母净利润14.04亿元、同比+147.74%；10月23日收于932.20元、+5.46%，但存货上升与第三季度经营现金流转负构成反证。
业绩
光迅科技三季度归母净利润翻倍
公司披露单季营收50.73亿元、同比+54.27%，归母净利润7.02亿元、同比+102.62%；10月23日收于128.63元、+0.81%，周末报告后尚无交易时段确认。
港股
东山精密H股发行价确定
港交所公告线索显示H股发行价定为86.80港元，预计10月28日主板挂牌；融资强化国际化平台，但新增股份、估值与上市后波动需要跟踪。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘
夜盘指数转强
约08:25 CST，道指、标普500、纳指100期货分别+0.34%、+0.48%、+0.66%；行情来自盘前公开市场快讯，属于延迟盘初快照。
对照
期指反弹与周五板块强弱形成背离
行业Top5/Bottom5及概念Top5代表股逐项查询：NE、RHI、TDW、TPET、HCC、OPTU、SNFCA、EPOW、AIRE、SMJF、LIDR、SAIL、APA、DVN、SKHY均未取得可核验夜盘成交，因此不以周五收盘替代；指数层面偏强但个股层面不可得，结论为背离而非确认。
映射
A/H开盘采用本地量价确认
期指回升缓和风险偏好压力，原油回落削弱能源追涨动能；A/H优先验证MLF落地、存储/光通信业绩股和恒生科技能否站稳前收，若高开回落或宽度未改善，夜盘反弹信号失效。

盘前结论

7000亿元MLF、AI就业政策及存储/光通信业绩为A/H提供结构性支撑。 但10月23日A股宽度显著偏弱，油价仍在高位且美国科技融资成本受审视。
基准判断是低开风险收敛、结构先于指数修复：期指反弹仅构成增量缓和，开盘仍以本地宽度和公告后价格为准。 若恒科、存储与光通信不能站稳前收，转向高股息与防守。

重点个股关注

德明利
SZ.001309
条件关注
事实与状态：三季度营收116.45亿元、归母净利润27.29亿元，存储概念美股涨2.19%；10月23日收盘251.00元、+3.22%，但报告周末披露，尚无公告后价格确认。
确认条件：开盘后不跌破前收且存储板块同步走强，放量后仍能维持相对强势。
风险与失效：高景气预期已较充分交易；若高开回落至前收下方、企业级存储增长弱于指引或板块转弱，关注逻辑失效。
光迅科技
SZ.002281
条件关注
事实与状态：三季度营收50.73亿元、归母净利润7.02亿元；10月23日收盘128.63元、+0.81%，周末披露后尚无交易确认。
确认条件：光通信板块与个股开盘后共同站稳前收，成交放大而非单笔拉升。
风险与失效：周四科技抛售仍压制估值；若个股跌破128.63元前收并持续弱于通信设备板块，撤销关注。
寒武纪
SH.688256
条件关注
事实与状态：三季度营收35.31亿元、归母净利润14.04亿元；10月23日收于932.20元、+5.46%，但报告披露后的有效交易确认尚未发生。
确认条件：开盘后守住前收且国产算力板块同步转强，量价延续至少一个完整观察窗口。
风险与失效：存货升至116.65亿元、第三季度经营现金流为负，且美股AI融资成本仍受审视；跌破前收并弱于科创50则转为回避。

板块轮动看板

受益方向
MLF支持的金融与高股息、业绩确认的存储和光通信；原油绝对高位仍支撑上游，但不追涨。
观察方向
激光雷达、网络安全、机器人数据生态；有美股主题但缺本地公司级催化，等待成交确认。
压力方向
高估值AI与美国电信映射；美股运营商竞争冲击不可机械外推，A/H运营商只作情绪风险提示。
验证信号
上证/恒科站稳前收、全市场下跌家数显著收敛，德明利/光迅科技公告后不低开走弱。

逻辑链

周五美股能源涨2.5%、油气钻探行业涨6.15%，中东供应风险抬高能源成本；周一原油回落使上游成为观察而非追涨。
7000亿元MLF与AI就业友好政策提供本地对冲，但10月23日A股下跌4872家、科创50跌3.07%的弱宽度要求降低开盘乐观度。
德明利、光迅科技、寒武纪业绩分别映射存储、光通信和国产算力；三者均需用公告后首个有效交易时段确认。
若期指反弹、恒科和本地科技股同时站稳前收，结构性修复成立；若高开回落且宽度不改善，转向防守。

风险雷达

中东冲突与沙特设施袭击可能令油价再度上冲，推高通胀和利率预期。
10月23日A股中位跌幅为-3.36%、4872家下跌，弱宽度可能吞噬政策利好。
德明利、光迅科技与寒武纪周末披露后尚无有效价格确认，禁止把旧收盘价当成当前买点。
15只美股排行代表股的夜盘报价均不可得，板块延续判断存在数据缺口。

数据来源与时间点

主要来源与时间：美股行业/概念排行来自Moomoo GitHub Action快照（2026-10-24 07:52 CST，对应10月23日现金时段）；美股收盘与电信/能源异动来自Reuters（10月23日）；运行时期指来自财联社盘前公开快讯（约08:25 CST），原油来自Reuters（08:18 CST），15只代表股夜盘报价均未取得。AKShare 1.18.94快照抓取于2026-10-23 12:51 CST，仅作上一交易时段盘中基线：A股642涨/4872跌/59平、中位-3.358%，港股799涨/867跌/1139平、中位0%；上证、深证、创业板、科创50及恒指/恒科接口分别为stock_zh_index_spot_sina与stock_hk_index_spot_sina。政策原始源：中国人民银行/新华社、国务院办公厅/中国政府网、上交所；公告源：巨潮资讯、上交所披露、公司公告与HKEX。国内发现源：财联社/东方财富早报、证券时报电子报；抓取截止2026-10-26 08:42 CST。

PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 indicate heat/importance, not percentage moves.
Major News Summary
Global
Middle East attacks persist as oil retreats from a near six-month high
Houthi attacks on Saudi airports and oil facilities continued over the weekend. At 08:18 CST Monday, WTI was $101.67, down 1.55%, and Brent $115.16, down 1.34%. The pullback eases marginal inflation pressure, but supply risk remains.
Policy
PBOC conducts RMB700bn of one-year MLF today
The central bank said on Oct 23 it would conduct RMB700bn of one-year MLF on Oct 26 through fixed quantity, rate bidding and multiple-price awards. This supports liquidity expectations; the clearing rate remains the key price signal.
Policy
State Council links AI development with employment-friendly transition
Document No. 29, published Oct 24, supports AI entrepreneurship, open-source communities, smart-terminal manufacturing and training while requiring assessments of job displacement. It supports software, compute and devices but adds compliance constraints.
Exchange
Revised Shanghai composite methodology takes effect today
The SSE adds a 15% cap for a single constituent and changes the removal timing for risk-warning securities. The effective date is today, potentially altering passive-flow effects in heavyweights and flagged stocks.
US
Oil and gas led while telecom services lagged
Moomoo’s Oct 23 industry table showed Oil & Gas Drilling +6.15% and Oilfield Services +4.94%; Reuters put energy +2.5%. Telecom Services fell 3.16%, while AT&T and T-Mobile each lost nearly 8% on possible SpaceX competition. The energy read-through is positive for A/H, but the telecom shock is largely US-specific.
US
Lidar, cybersecurity and storage concepts strengthened
Lidar rose 5.78% (LIDR +10.41%), Cybersecurity 4.55% (SAIL +8.62%) and Storage 2.19% (SKHY +4.05%). These map to A/H smart driving, security software and memory, but representative overnight quotes are unavailable despite firmer Monday futures.
Industry
AgiBot opens a real-world embodied reasoning dataset
A domestic morning discovery source says AGIBOT WORLD 2026 Phase IV covers nine real-world reasoning categories with action trajectories. This helps robotics data and training ecosystems, but no listed-company order or revenue confirmation was found, so no stock card is created.
Earnings
Techwinsemi posts sharp quarterly revenue and profit growth
The CNInfo filing shows quarterly revenue of RMB11.645bn, up 356.64%, and attributable net profit of RMB2.729bn, up 2,902.75%, with enterprise storage gaining mix. The stock closed Oct 23 at CNY251.00, up 3.22%; no post-filing session has occurred.
Earnings
Cambricon doubles quarterly revenue and profit
The quarterly report shows revenue of RMB3.531bn, up 104.47%, and attributable net profit of RMB1.404bn, up 147.74%. The stock closed Oct 23 at CNY932.20, up 5.46%, but higher inventory and negative third-quarter operating cash flow are counterevidence.
Earnings
Accelink doubles quarterly attributable profit
The filing shows quarterly revenue of RMB5.073bn, up 54.27%, and attributable net profit of RMB702m, up 102.62%. The stock closed Oct 23 at CNY128.63, up 0.81%; no trading session has occurred after the weekend filing.
Hong Kong
Dongshan Precision fixes its H-share offer price
An HKEX announcement trail shows an offer price of HKD86.80 and expected Main Board trading on Oct 28. The listing broadens the funding platform, while dilution, valuation and post-listing volatility require monitoring.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Indices
Overnight index futures turn higher
Around 08:25 CST, Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures were +0.34%, +0.48% and +0.66%. These are delayed early-session figures from a public market briefing.
Cross-check
Firmer futures diverge from Friday’s sector pattern
Overnight trades were checked for all Top5/Bottom5 and Concept Top5 representatives: NE, RHI, TDW, TPET, HCC, OPTU, SNFCA, EPOW, AIRE, SMJF, LIDR, SAIL, APA, DVN and SKHY. No verifiable overnight prints were available, so Friday closes are not substituted. Stronger index futures with unavailable stock-level data are classified as divergence, not confirmation.
A/H Mapping
Use local price and breadth for opening confirmation
Firmer futures ease risk pressure while lower oil reduces chase risk in energy. A/H confirmation requires MLF execution, storage/optical earnings names and HSTECH to hold prior closes; a failed gap-up or unimproved breadth invalidates the signal.

Pre-Open Takeaway

RMB700bn MLF, the AI employment policy and storage/optical earnings provide structural support for A/H. Yet Oct 23 A-share breadth was weak, oil remains elevated and US technology financing costs are under scrutiny.
The base case is narrower downside risk and structural recovery before index recovery: firmer futures only ease pressure, while local breadth and post-filing prices remain decisive. If HSTECH, storage and optical communications fail to hold prior closes, favor high-dividend defense.

Focused Stocks

Techwinsemi
SZ.001309
Conditional Watch
Facts and status: Quarterly revenue was RMB11.645bn and attributable profit RMB2.729bn; the US storage concept rose 2.19%. The stock closed Oct 23 at CNY251.00, +3.22%, but the weekend filing has no post-release price confirmation.
Confirmation: Hold above the prior close after the open while the storage group strengthens, with sustained volume rather than a brief spike.
Risk and invalidation: Expectations are elevated. A fade below the prior close, weaker enterprise-storage growth, or sector reversal invalidates the watch.
Accelink Technologies
SZ.002281
Conditional Watch
Facts and status: Quarterly revenue was RMB5.073bn and attributable profit RMB702m. The stock closed Oct 23 at CNY128.63, +0.81%; the weekend filing has no post-release trading confirmation.
Confirmation: The stock and optical-communications group both hold above their prior closes with broader volume.
Risk and invalidation: Thursday’s tech selloff still weighs on valuation. A drop below CNY128.63 with persistent sector underperformance cancels the watch.
Cambricon
SH.688256
Conditional Watch
Facts and status: Quarterly revenue was RMB3.531bn and attributable profit RMB1.404bn. The stock closed Oct 23 at CNY932.20, +5.46%, but no valid post-filing session has occurred.
Confirmation: Hold the prior close after the open as the domestic AI-compute group strengthens for a full observation window.
Risk and invalidation: Inventory reached RMB11.665bn, third-quarter operating cash flow was negative, and US AI financing costs remain under scrutiny. A break below the prior close with STAR 50 underperformance turns the stance to Avoid.

Sector Rotation Board

Beneficiaries
MLF-supported financials and high dividend names, plus storage and optical names with earnings. Elevated oil still supports upstream plays, but avoid chasing.
Watch
Lidar, cybersecurity and robotics data ecosystems. US themes are firm but local company catalysts are incomplete; wait for turnover confirmation.
Pressure
High-multiple AI and telecom read-throughs. The US carrier shock is not mechanically transferable; A/H operators are only a sentiment risk.
Validation
Shanghai and HSTECH hold prior closes, decliners narrow materially, and Techwinsemi/Accelink avoid post-filing weakness.

Logic Chain

Friday energy gained 2.5% and Oil & Gas Drilling 6.15% as Middle East supply risk lifted costs; Monday’s crude retreat makes upstream a watch rather than a chase.
RMB700bn MLF and the AI employment policy provide local offsets, but 4,872 A-share decliners and a 3.07% STAR 50 drop in the Oct 23 snapshot cap opening optimism.
Techwinsemi, Accelink and Cambricon map to storage, optical communications and domestic AI compute; each needs confirmation in the first valid post-filing session.
A structural rebound requires firmer futures, HSTECH and local technology stocks to hold prior closes together; a failed gap-up without breadth improvement favors defense.

Risk Radar

Middle East escalation or further attacks on Saudi facilities could reaccelerate oil, inflation and rate expectations.
The Oct 23 A-share median move was -3.36% with 4,872 decliners; weak breadth can overwhelm policy support.
Techwinsemi, Accelink and Cambricon have no valid post-weekend filing price confirmation; old closes are not current entry points.
Overnight quotes were unavailable for all 15 ranking representatives, leaving a stock-level data gap.

Sources and Timestamps
